name: Separating a Sand and Salt Mixture
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; exact Class 8 chapter and page to verify
educational_goal: Demonstrate filtration, evaporation, and recovery of components from a sand and salt mixture.
safety_notes: Use heat only with adult supervision.

scenes.description: A school laboratory bench shows a funnel filtering a sand-salt mixture into a beaker and an evaporating dish nearby.

steps.description: Add water to the sand and salt mixture and stir thoroughly.
steps.observation: Salt dissolves while sand remains as solid particles.
steps.key_visual: Salt dissolves while sand remains as solid particles.

scenes.description: A school laboratory bench shows a funnel filtering a sand-salt mixture into a beaker and an evaporating dish nearby.

steps.description: Pour the mixture through folded filter paper in a funnel.
steps.observation: Sand remains on the filter paper and salt solution collects below.
steps.key_visual: Sand remains on the filter paper and salt solution collects below.

steps.description: Transfer the filtrate to an evaporating dish and warm it gently.
steps.observation: Water evaporates and solid salt crystals remain.
steps.key_visual: Water evaporates and solid salt crystals remain.

scenes.description: A school laboratory bench shows a funnel filtering a sand-salt mixture into a beaker and an evaporating dish nearby.

steps.description: Compare the recovered sand and salt with the original mixture.
steps.observation: Both components are recovered by using different physical properties.
steps.key_visual: Both components are recovered by using different physical properties.
